plannedSets.description: What the plan asks for, one entry per set.

supersetWithNext.description: When true, this exercise is performed back-to-back with the following one (a superset), with no rest in between.

link.description: A url to some explanation of how to do this. We should not fill this unless the user has explicitly given us a link to fill

progression.description: Ordered; the first rule that can still move, moves. Empty means no automatic progression.

resistance.description: Where this movement's load comes from: the whole stored weight (`external`), what is added on top of the lifter (`bodyweight`), or nothing at all (`none`, e.g. crunches).
